description: Plan word-level filler removal (um, uh, you know...) from a revision-bound word timeline. Hesitation-sound removal requires a transcript that preserves disfluencies, such as Premiere transcription or verbatim ASR; Whisper's default output omits them. Returns frame-snapped removal and keep ranges plus apply routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

filler_words.description: Filler words or multi-word phrases to remove (matched as consecutive normalized tokens). Defaults to: um, uh, er, ah, hmm, you know, i mean, sort of, kind of. 'like' is only removed when listed explicitly.

frame_rate.description: Timebase used to snap ranges to whole frames; defaults to 30.

handle_frames.description: Frames of handle left inside each removal so cuts are not tight; defaults to 1.

max_removals.description: Maximum merged removals to return; defaults to 256.

merge_gap_seconds.description: Removals separated by less than this are merged into one cut; defaults to 0.15.

min_confidence.description: Optional: only remove fillers whose every word carries a confidence at or above this value.

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

name: plan_filler_word_removal

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.

title: Plan Filler Word Removal
